responsibility: This implementation provides fixed-format input/output conversion for floating-point and long-integer values in the mc-boot runtime. It reads textual numbers through StrIO, delegates parsing and formatting to DynamicStrings and StringConvert, and writes formatted results back to standard string I/O, making it the stream-oriented numeric I/O adapter for REAL, LONGREAL, and LONGINT rather than the lower-level conversion engine itself.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable adapters behind GFpuIO.h: it reads and writes via StrIO and performs REAL/LONGREAL/LONGINT text conversions by calling DynamicStrings and StringConvert routines.
